message: Goal: blink an LED 1 s on / 1 s off with the cheapest parts (two 2N3904 astable multivibrator, 5 V), checked in simulation.

note: First design: RB 62k, C 22uF (t = 0.76*RB*C = 1.04 s per half), RC1/RL 330 ohm
Fix: halves were 0.71 s / 0.73 s (t = 0.53*RB*C, not 0.76); RB1 75k, RB2 68k, C 27uF for ~1 s each
Fix: start from a 1 ms power-on ramp (the balanced operating point took 3.7 s to break); RB2 82k for a 1 s off time (was 0.85 s)
